description: AI Rules Engine - Device monitoring and optimization rules

rules.name: Idle Device with No Consumers
rules.description: Device is connected and emitting data, but no consumers are using it

recommendation.action: Turn off this device to save energy
recommendation.reason: Device is emitting data but has zero consumers - pure energy waste

rules.name: Connected but Not Emitting Data
rules.description: Device is connected to network but not transmitting any data

recommendation.action: Consider turning off or investigating this idle device
recommendation.reason: Device is connected but completely idle - no data transmission

rules.name: Device Powered but Not Connected
rules.description: Device is consuming power but not connected to the network

recommendation.action: Turn off disconnected device or check network connection
recommendation.reason: Device is consuming power without being connected to the network

rules.name: Frequent Device Restarts
rules.description: Device is restarting too frequently, reducing its lifespan

recommendation.action: Investigate and fix the root cause of frequent restarts
recommendation.reason: Frequent restarts reduce device lifespan and indicate potential issues
recommendation.impact: Prevents hardware failure and extends device life

rules.name: High CPU Usage
rules.description: Device is operating under high load conditions

recommendation.action: Redistribute load or upgrade device capacity
recommendation.reason: High CPU usage may lead to performance degradation and potential failures

recommendation.action: Immediately redistribute load or add capacity
recommendation.reason: Critical CPU overload can cause system failure and downtime

rules.name: Voltage Anomalies Detected
rules.description: Device experiencing voltage spikes or irregularities

recommendation.action: Check power supply and electrical connections immediately
recommendation.reason: Voltage spikes can damage equipment and create safety hazards
recommendation.impact: Prevents equipment damage and safety issues

rules.name: High Data Flow with Low Consumer Count
rules.description: Device is pushing high data volume but has few consumers

recommendation.action: Optimize data distribution or reduce data flow rate
recommendation.reason: High data output with few consumers suggests inefficient resource usage
recommendation.impact: Optimizes network bandwidth and device performance

rules.name: Low Device Uptime
rules.description: Device uptime is below acceptable threshold

recommendation.action: Investigate reliability issues and perform maintenance
recommendation.reason: Low uptime indicates frequent failures or connectivity issues

rules.name: Stale Data Emission
rules.description: Device hasn't emitted data recently despite being active

recommendation.action: Check device sensors or data pipeline
recommendation.reason: Device is active but hasn't transmitted data recently - possible malfunction
recommendation.impact: Ensures data quality and device functionality

rules.name: Optimal Device Performance
rules.description: Device is operating within optimal parameters

recommendation.action: No action required - device is performing optimally
recommendation.reason: All metrics are within healthy ranges

rules.name: Load Bank Near Capacity
rules.description: Load Bank is operating at high capacity and may need expansion

recommendation.action: Plan for Load Bank capacity expansion or load distribution
recommendation.reason: Load Bank is operating at over 85% capacity - risk of overload
recommendation.impact: Prevents power supply failures and ensures system reliability

rules.name: Load Bank Critical Overload
rules.description: Load Bank is critically overloaded and at risk of failure

recommendation.action: Immediately reduce load or add additional Load Bank capacity
recommendation.reason: Load Bank is at critical capacity - imminent risk of power supply failure
recommendation.impact: Prevents catastrophic power failures and equipment damage

rules.name: Load Bank Low Efficiency
rules.description: Load Bank operating at suboptimal efficiency

recommendation.action: Schedule Load Bank maintenance and efficiency optimization
recommendation.reason: Load Bank efficiency below 90% - increased energy waste and costs
recommendation.impact: Improves energy efficiency and reduces operational costs

rules.name: Load Bank High Temperature
rules.description: Load Bank temperature exceeds safe operating range

recommendation.action: Check cooling system and reduce load if necessary
recommendation.reason: Load Bank temperature above 50°C - risk of thermal damage
recommendation.impact: Prevents thermal damage and extends equipment lifespan

rules.name: Load Bank Optimal Operation
rules.description: Load Bank is operating within optimal parameters

recommendation.action: No action required - Load Bank is performing optimally
recommendation.reason: All Load Bank metrics are within healthy ranges

scoring.description: Health score calculation (100% = optimal, 0% = critical issues)
